preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of nodes n in the tree must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of nodes in each subtree must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in x1) and all(1 <= y <= n for y in y2)
preconditions.description: All node labels in the subtrees must be valid node indices.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'C s' where s is a common node label or -1 if no common node exists
postconditions.description: The output must be 'C s' where s is a label of a common node or -1 if no common node exists.
